calibrated_probability_below_watch_thres.title: Risk probability below watch threshold
calibrated_probability_below_watch_thres.detail: The calibrated risk probability is below the configured watch threshold.

calibration_drift_abstain.title: Calibration drift abstention
calibration_drift_abstain.detail: Multiple calibration-drift signals crossed threshold, so the serving decision abstains.

calibration_drift_brier_increase.title: Brier score degraded
calibration_drift_brier_increase.detail: The later window's Brier score increased beyond the configured threshold.

calibration_drift_detected.title: Calibration drift detected
calibration_drift_detected.detail: Calibration reliability degraded in the later labeled window, so trust was reduced.

calibration_drift_ece_increase.title: Calibration error increased
calibration_drift_ece_increase.detail: The later window's expected calibration error increased beyond the configured threshold.

calibration_drift_event_rate_shift.title: Event-rate shift
calibration_drift_event_rate_shift.detail: The later labeled event rate shifted beyond the configured calibration-drift threshold.

calibration_drift_not_evaluated.title: Calibration drift not evaluated
calibration_drift_not_evaluated.detail: No later labeled window was available, so serving could not check calibration drift.

calibration_drift_stable.title: Calibration drift stable
calibration_drift_stable.detail: The later labeled window did not cross the configured event-rate, ECE, or Brier drift thresholds.

calibration_slope_nonpositive.title: Recent ranking did not hold
calibration_slope_nonpositive.detail: In the calibration window, higher model scores did not mean more drawdowns. The model's ranking is kept and only its probability level is adjusted, so treat this ranking as unconfirmed.

conformal_set_ambiguous.title: Outcomes not separable
conformal_set_ambiguous.detail: The conformal prediction set contains both drawdown and no drawdown at the configured coverage.

conformal_set_drawdown_only.title: Conformal set: drawdown
conformal_set_drawdown_only.detail: At the configured coverage, the conformal prediction set contains only the drawdown outcome.

conformal_set_empty.title: Conformal set empty
conformal_set_empty.detail: The conformal prediction set is empty, which indicates an unusual calibrated probability for this batch.

conformal_set_no_drawdown_only.title: Conformal set: no drawdown
conformal_set_no_drawdown_only.detail: At the configured coverage, the conformal prediction set contains only the no-drawdown outcome.

conformal_set_unavailable.title: Conformal set unavailable
conformal_set_unavailable.detail: The calibration window did not contain both outcomes, so no conformal set was computed.

ensemble_disagreement_high.title: Model refits disagree
ensemble_disagreement_high.detail: Models refit on resampled market days disagree more than on most recent labeled rows, so treat the probability as less stable.

input_out_of_distribution.title: Unusual market conditions
input_out_of_distribution.detail: The latest features are far from the training data. Historically these periods carried higher drawdown rates, so a low reading is not reassuring.

insufficient_history.title: Insufficient price history
insufficient_history.detail: The ticker has market data, but not enough labeled history for a calibrated risk prediction.

limited_data_quality.title: Limited data quality
limited_data_quality.detail: The ticker has a short labeled history or stale bars, so trust was reduced.

probability_above_alert_threshold.title: Risk probability above alert threshold
probability_above_alert_threshold.detail: The calibrated risk probability is at or above the configured alert threshold.

probability_above_watch_threshold.title: Risk probability above watch threshold
probability_above_watch_threshold.detail: The calibrated risk probability is at or above the configured watch threshold.

reliability_unavailable.title: Reliability unavailable
reliability_unavailable.detail: Reliability signals could not be fitted (for example single-class history), so trust was set to zero.

stale_ticker_data.title: Stale ticker data
stale_ticker_data.detail: The ticker's latest bar is older than the latest bar in this batch.

trust_above_alert_threshold.title: Trust score above alert threshold
trust_above_alert_threshold.detail: The trust score is high enough to support an alert decision.

trust_below_alert_threshold.title: Trust score below alert threshold
trust_below_alert_threshold.detail: The trust score is not high enough to support an alert decision.

uncertainty_above_threshold.title: Uncertainty above threshold
uncertainty_above_threshold.detail: The uncertainty score is above the configured threshold.

uncertainty_below_threshold.title: Uncertainty below threshold
uncertainty_below_threshold.detail: The uncertainty score is below the configured threshold.

warning_level_abstain.title: Abstain warning level
warning_level_abstain.detail: The final warning decision is abstain because confidence is limited.

warning_level_alert.title: Alert warning level
warning_level_alert.detail: The final warning decision is alert.

warning_level_no_alert.title: No alert warning level
warning_level_no_alert.detail: The final warning decision is no alert.

warning_level_watch.title: Watch warning level
warning_level_watch.detail: The final warning decision is watch.
